text:
anya: Escalation: ACME reports 405 Method Not Allowed when calling chat.create via @redwood/sdk v0.24. Root error from API: "Unknown endpoint: /v1/chat.create"

support-engineer: Repro steps I used:
1) node 18
2) npm i @redwood/sdk@0.24
3) code:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk';
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.KEY });
await c.chat.create({ model: 'rw1-small', input: 'hello' });
```
Response:
```json
{ "status": 405, "error": "Unknown endpoint: /v1/chat.create" }
```

jordan: Looks like the SDK is constructing the route with a dot: `/v1/chat.create`. Recent API gateway rejects dot routes. We changed canonical routes to slashed paths a while back.

sam: Confirmed in changelog: SDK v0.25 added automatic route mapping to slashes; v0.24 still emits dot notation. Customer is on API version that no longer accepts dot routes.

devx-bot: changelog link: https://redwood.internal/changelog/sdk#v0.25

maria: Temporary workaround: call REST path directly (bypass route resolver) or upgrade SDK. Example:
```js
// bypassing SDK route resolver and using low-level request helper
await c.request('POST','/v1/chat/create', { model: 'rw1-small', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hi' }] });
```
Also note 'input' -> 'messages' param rename in newer API; sending 'input' will be ignored in some handlers.

jordan: Can add compat shim in runtime to accept dot routes or return 404->map rule, but that's risky. Better to publish a patch for SDK that normalizes routes for older API clients.

support-engineer: I've asked customer to try upgrading to @redwood/sdk@0.26 and to test with messages param. Waiting on their confirmation.

sam: Created ticket RW-SDK-872 to add mapping layer and add a test in sdk-compat matrix. Assigned to eng-runtime.

maria: Assigning to @eng-runtime to decide whether API should accept legacy dotted routes with header 'X-RW-Compat: legacy-route' for 60 days.

support-engineer: I'll follow up with customer and close after confirmation. :thumbsup:
